value.rationale: Left orthogonal row mixing preserves a linear system normal matrix, singular spectrum and signed KGSM dynamics, yet changes actual mean-square convergence into exponential blowup at the identical source-admissible parameter point. This demonstrates a substantive, directly actionable limitation of spectral-only momentum tuning and motivates the full row-projector second moment. The explicit exact Lyapunov and growth matrices give a reusable analytical benchmark beyond simulations or a routine numerical example.
